row: Welcome to Animal Trust’s official YouTube channel. We’re a not-for-profit veterinary organisation dedicated to making veterinary care accessible and affordable for all pet owners. Here, our experienced vets share practical advice, pet health tips, and expert insights to help you keep your pets happy and healthy. You’ll also find videos from our clinics, guides on common pet conditions, and advice on when to seek veterinary care. Subscribe to learn more about how we support pets and their owners across the UK, and to get trusted information directly from vets.
